title: Kanban board with scrolling columns
summary: Fixed-width columns in a horizontal row, each scrolling on its own when its cards overflow.
explanation: The board is a flex row that scrolls sideways with overflow-x: auto. Each column is flex: 0 0 200px, so it keeps its width instead of shrinking to fit, and the row overflows the board.

Each column is also a flex column with a fixed height and overflow-y: auto. A column with many cards scrolls by itself while the others stay put. For that to work the column needs a definite height, and min-width: 0 stops long card titles from forcing it wider.
align-items: flex-start on the board keeps columns at their own height. Without it, short columns would stretch to match the longest one, and the background of each would look like a tall empty box.
tryThis: Remove overflow-y: auto from .column: the cards spill out of the grey panel instead of scrolling.
Change flex to 1 1 200px: the columns now shrink to share the width and the board stops scrolling sideways.
Add more .task cards to Todo and watch only that column scroll.
